topic: Debates in Contemporary Society (Families & Relationships / Youth / Media)
subject: sociology

items.q: Has the nuclear family always been the only family type?
items.correct: No — family diversity is widespread and has changed over time.
items.misconception: Yes, the nuclear family is the only natural form.
items.why: Lone-parent, extended, reconstituted and same-sex families are all common today.

items.q: Is family life the same across all cultures and time?
items.correct: No — family forms and roles vary across cultures and history.
items.random_wrong: Only one family type has ever existed.
items.why: Sociologists document wide diversity in family structure and roles.
